payload.focus: Sprint retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This sprint retro touches the core product thesis (async decision capture at consensus), the anti-Slack positioning narrative, the Zephyr integration unlock, velocity metrics, and pricing evolution. I expanded the full AntiSlackPositioning narrative and its children (product category, target market, anti-pattern real-time chat) because the retro's 'async decision widget' is the concrete instantiation of that thesis. I included the Zephyr integration position, rate-limit resolution, and webhook architecture since the document names Zephyr as the key unlock. Pricing positions ($12→$15) and the context-preservation next-sprint position are included because the retro's velocity and shipped-feature claims bear on those threads. The DecisionsEvaporate narrative and CoreFeatureDecisionCapture position are included as the foundational problem and feature the widget addresses. I did not expand the Thematic/People/Documents doors because the focus-scoped tail and narrative expansions already surfaced every relevant node.
